info.title: Sentinel-X API
info.description: AI-assisted security investigation platform: correlates security telemetry, reconstructs attack timelines and entity relationships, and assists analysts with evidence-backed findings.

post.summary: Change your own password (signs out every other session; audited)

get.description: Public verification keys, so other services can validate access tokens without secrets.

schema.title: Response Jwks  Well Known Jwks Json Get

delete.description: Soft delete: accounts are deactivated, never destroyed (docs/05 §8).

schema.title: Response List Roles Api V1 Roles Get
Response List Permissions Api V1 Permissions Get

parameters.name: source_id

schema.description: Required when using a user access token
schema.title: Source Id

parameters.description: Required when using a user access token

schema.title: Response List Parsers Api V1 Ingest Parsers Get
Response List Sources Api V1 Ingest Sources Get

patch.summary: Enable or disable an ingest source

schema.title: Response Get Event Api V1 Events  Event Uid  Get

get.summary: Fetch one finding with its evidence event ids

schema.title: Response List Rules Api V1 Detection Rules Get

get.summary: List incidents, most recent activity first
Fetch an incident with its links, entities and assessment

patch.summary: Change the status of an incident (audited)

get.summary: The attack timeline: evidence events in order, grouped into steps
The incident as a MITRE ATT&CK Navigator layer (v4.5), scored by events per technique

schema.title: Response Get Navigator Layer Api V1 Incidents  Incident Id  Exports Attack Navigator Get

get.summary: The incident as a STIX 2.1 Attack Flow bundle; each action cites its events

schema.title: Response Get Attack Flow Api V1 Incidents  Incident Id  Exports Attack Flow Get

get.summary: The incident as a Markdown report: timeline, findings, entities and notes, all citing events
The entity graph: every edge cites the events that state it
Digests of the evidence events and the links that cite them

schema.title: Response List Notes Api V1 Incidents  Incident Id  Notes Get

get.summary: The configured threat-intelligence providers (may be none)

schema.title: Response List Providers Api V1 Intel Providers Get

post.summary: Cached intel for indicators. Never calls a provider: enrichment runs in the background

get.summary: Whether the AI assistant is configured, and with which model
Recorded AI analyses of an incident, newest first

schema.title: Response List Analyses Api V1 Incidents  Incident Id  Analyses Get

post.summary: Ask the AI assistant to analyse an incident (recorded and audited, whatever the outcome)

bundle_hash.title: Bundle Hash
bundle_hash.description: SHA-256 of the exact evidence the model was given

output.title: Output
output.description: The validated analysis: summary, FACT / INFERENCE / UNCERTAINTY statements, techniques, next steps

dropped.title: Dropped
dropped.description: What validation removed, each with the reason

citation_validity.title: Citation Validity
citation_validity.description: Share of the model's citations that existed in the evidence

entry_hash.title: Entry Hash
entry_hash.description: SHA-256 link in the tamper-evident chain

raw.title: Raw
raw.description: Excerpt of the original record (at most 2,048 characters); null without event:read

version.title: Version
version.description: Send back when changing the status; a stale version is a 409

links.title: Links
links.description: Whether this entity can join findings into the incident

events.title: Events
events.description: event_uids it was seen in (at most 20)

rule.title: Rule
rule.description: The correlation rule that created the link

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: event_uids this link brings into the incident

version.title: Version
version.description: Send back when changing the status; a stale version is a 409

skipped.title: Skipped
skipped.description: Keys that aren't indicators Sentinel-X looks up (e.g. internal IPs)

verdict.title: Verdict
verdict.description: The provider's own classification; Sentinel-X does not merge providers

incident_events.title: Incident Events
incident_events.description: event_uids already in the incident that show this entity

new_events.title: New Events
new_events.description: event_uids of the linked item that show this entity

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: `local` (a file this deployment loads) or `external` (a third-party service)

SourceWithToken.title: SourceWithToken
SourceWithToken.description: Returned only by create and rotate: the token is never retrievable afterwards.

unresolved_events.title: Unresolved Events
unresolved_events.description: Evidence event_uids with no recorded digest, so absent from the timeline and graph

id.title: Id
id.description: event_uid of the first event in the step

remote.title: Remote
remote.description: The other side: the client of a logon, or the far end of a connection

citations.title: Citations
citations.description: Findings and correlation links citing these events

events.title: Events
events.description: event_uids this step stands for, in time order
